Scenario fixture: meta-viewport-zoom-enabled

01 — FAIL: viewport meta sets user-scalable=no

This rule inspects the document's own <meta name="viewport"> tag, so only one scenario can be demonstrated per page (a document has at most one meaningful viewport meta). The PASS case (viewport allows zoom, or no viewport meta at all — this rule is then not applicable) is covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file rather than a second fixture file.
